title: Rav Idi son of Rav Ika
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yevamot 43a, where Rav Huna bar Manoach speaks in his name; and in Gittin 84b Rav Ada son of Rav Ika is mentioned.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Yevamot 43a paragraph has Rav Huna bar Manoach in the name of Rav Idi son of Rav Ika. The whole Gittin 84b paragraph names Rav Ada son of Rav Ika. The local full titles, nested reporting direction and distinct Idi/Ada forms remain without assigning the fathers a common identity.
